values.note: Every RV site has electric: $43-45 a night; full hookups $50 (Sunday-Wednesday nights). Thursday-Saturday +$7 on electric, +$10 on full hookup. No out-of-state camping rate (the park entrance fee differs by plates). Indiana's rate page gives only statewide ranges; these are the booking site's prices for April 2027 nights, read 2026-10-31.

hookups.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/spring-mill-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IN&parkId=570054 (Full Hookup: 35 sites '20/30/50', 9 at 30; Electric: all 30), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Electric sites are 30-amp; 50-amp comes only with full hookup. RA's per-site vehicle lengths run 30-109 ft; every site fits a 23-ft rig.

sites.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/parks-lakes/spring-mill-state-park/ ('Electric - 178 sites', 'Full Hookup - 45 sites') + reserveamerica per-site (20 Electric are Pull-Through; all 44 Full Hookup Back-In), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/parks-lakes/spring-mill-state-park/ ('Dumping station'; 'Camp store: April 15 to May 15 ...'), read 2026-10-31

note: Spring Mill Lake (no swimming) is west of the campground; sites are not lakefront. --Claude
